# Dorian Guzman

> Co-founder of NXT Partners AI. Builds AI systems and the business around them: multi-agent AI in production, strategy and operations, and go-to-market for private equity and financial services. Based in Amsterdam, working remotely.

## Profile

- [Homepage](https://dorianguzman.github.io/): One-page profile. Engineer, strategist and operator in one seat: takes AI from roadmap and business case through multi-agent systems in production to the commercial close.
- [CV (PDF)](https://dorianguzman.github.io/assets/cv/dorian-guzman-cv.pdf): Full CV, focused on AI transformation and value creation.

## Proof

- $140K: average deal size of NXT Partners AI's first enterprise clients.
- 0 to 100+: accounts grown at QStarlabs, with the go-to-market motion built from scratch.
- 100+ per week: assets produced by autonomous multi-agent workflows running in production.
- YC W22: Head of Data Science at SmartHelio.

## Disciplines

- Build: multi-agent AI systems from prototype to production. Pipeline orchestration, LLM evaluation and observability, vector databases, Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Gemini, Cloud Run), Python, FastAPI, React. Quant trading infrastructure.
- Strategy and operations: AI roadmaps, business cases and workflow redesign. Product ownership, team leadership, and AI value creation across the investment cycle: before the deal, the deal, after the deal.
- Go-to-market: outbound prospecting, C-level discovery, negotiation and close. GTM motions built from zero. Technical onboarding, adoption and expansion.

Sectors: private equity, financial services, energy, media, compliance and regulatory, DeFi.

## Experience

- [NXT Partners AI](https://dorianguzman.github.io/#experience), Co-Founder, Apr 2026 to present, New York (remote): AI transformation and strategy consultancy for private equity and financial services, from roadmap through implementation. Owns the full commercial cycle. Product: https://pe.nxtpartners.ai, an AI platform for PE covering sourcing, due diligence, portfolio monitoring and LP reporting.
- [QStarlabs](https://dorianguzman.github.io/#experience), Lead Product Engineer, Apr 2025 to Apr 2026, New York (remote): co-led business development and technical strategy for Personas, an enterprise AI agent platform; grew the customer base from zero to 100+ accounts.
- [Deep Q Digital](https://dorianguzman.github.io/#experience), Quantitative Researcher, Nov 2023 to Apr 2026, New York (remote): quantitative trading infrastructure for DeFi and live high-frequency operations across crypto markets.
- [SmartHelio (YC W22)](https://dorianguzman.github.io/#experience), Head of Data Science, May 2021 to Apr 2023, Lausanne, Switzerland: led an international data science team as Product Owner; ML fault detection and digital twins.
- [Fraunhofer ISE](https://dorianguzman.github.io/#experience), Project Manager and Data Scientist, Feb 2017 to Feb 2021, Freiburg, Germany: advised international clients on PV forecasting, performance analysis and system design.

## Education

- MBA, University of St. Gallen (HSG), 2022 to 2024. Thesis: Risk Management for DeFi Liquidity Provisioning.
- PhD candidate in Data Science, University of Freiburg with Fraunhofer ISE. Thesis submitted, defense pending. Paper featured in Rising Stars in Energy Research: 2022 (Frontiers in Energy Research): https://doi.org/10.3389/fenrg.2023.1060215
- Guest PhD, DTU, Copenhagen, Denmark (2019); EIT InnoEnergy PhD School.
- MSc Global Production Engineering, TU Berlin, 2013 to 2016.
- BSc Mechatronics, Tecnológico de Monterrey, 2006 to 2010.

Languages: English (fluent), Spanish (native), German (B1).
